Kai: quick heads-up — running into a weird case with the batch helper when we mix en/fr inputs. some embeddings come back with 1536 dims and others 1024 in the same batch. failing the downstream rerank pipeline. anyone seen this? :thinking:
Anna: that sounds like a model-variant mismatch. are we batching across model types? which SDK method are you using?
Kai: using python client v0.8.2, calling `client.embeddings.create(batch=...)` with an array of texts. all items specify model: 'open-embed-large' but our router might fallback to 'open-embed-small' on capacity. logs show mixed model ids.
Ryan: fallback routing could do that. we should never mix dims in one RPC. sdk should validate dims on response and surface a clear error instead of silently returning shorter vectors. can you paste the response snippet?
Kai: here's the log dump:```
INFO: request 0x7f - model=open-embed-large -> started
INFO: request 0x7f - model=open-embed-small -> fallback due to capacity
RECV: [[0.12, 0.01, ...]] length=1024
RECV: [[0.05, 0.03, ...]] length=1536
```
Maya: ugh. also saw streaming embeddings sometimes truncate if the chunk boundary coincides with kv cache cut. streaming path needs to reassemble and sanity-check length.
Anna: two fixes: 1) SDK-level consistency check that rejects batch if any vector length differs; 2) router should avoid mixing variants for same batch request (maybe group by model hash). both fairly small.
Kai: agreed. one more wrinkle — auth token refresh is causing a retry flow that re-sends a subset of items resulting in duplicate items from client viewpoint. combined with the mixed-model problem, we get corrupted batches.
Ryan: is that the oauth refresh middleware? we recently changed it to auto-retry once on 401. it retries the whole request but the client lib library-level de-dup is opt-in.
Anna: proposal: change retry to fail fast on 401 (no automatic replay) and expose a helper that does idempotent-batched-retry where callers can attach unique ids. also add a strict mode to embeddings.create that validates dims and raises `ValueError` when inconsistent.
Maya: sounds good. I'll sketch a tiny patch: add param `validate_dims=True|False` default True for batched endpoints, and a `batch_id` header to support idempotency in retries.
Kai: if someone can review the patch today I'll cut a hotfix. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4827>
Anna: pinged for review. linking CI job that surfaced the failure: <https://ci.redwood-inference.com/12345>
ci-bot: build #12345 failed — 1 test failed (tests/embeddings/test_batch_consistency.py::test_mixed_model_dims)
Ryan: small note on backoff: for streaming paths we already use linear backoff because exponential can skew chunk order if resumed. keep that in mind when changing retry semantics.
Maya: I'll add unit tests: simulate router fallback to different model ids and assert handler raises. also add a quick fix in the batch helper to pre-group inputs by preferred model variant when `group_by_model=True` to avoid mixing.
Kai: PR updated with tests + docs. changelog entry: "embeddings: strict-dim validation, opt-in idempotent batching, prevent model-mix across single RPC"
Anna: LGTM aside from one naming nit (use `validate_dims` -> `strict_dim_check`). leaving review comment now. :thumbsup:
Kai: thanks! will merge after Anna approves and then cut 0.8.3 hotfix. can someone notify support/partners channel post-release?
Ryan: I'll take post-release announcement. also opening a follow-up ticket to add server-side enforcement to reject mixed-dim responses earlier: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGML-827
Maya: will monitor errors in Sentry and add a regression test in our e2e harness.
Kai: awesome. closing loop — thanks for the quick sync.
